Loops Master for Mac
All-in-one mastering for riddim: layers, EQ, multiband, duck, clip, limit and meters.

Requirements
  macOS 10.13 or newer, Apple silicon or Intel
  Ableton Live 10.1 or newer (Live 11 or 12 recommended)

Install
  1. Close Live.
  2. In Finder, choose Go > Go to Folder and enter:
       /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3
  3. Drag "LoopsMaster.vst3" into that folder. Enter your Mac password if asked.
  4. Open Live. In Settings > Plug-Ins, turn on "Use VST3 Plug-In System Folders",
     then click Rescan.
  5. Loops Master is in the browser under Plug-Ins > VST3 > Loops.

Uninstall
  Delete /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/LoopsMaster.vst3

Using it on the master
  Put Loops Master last on the master track.
  Keep the mix peaking around 0 dB or lower before it; the meters show the input level.
  The Duck section listens to the sidechain input. Send it your kick only, not the whole mix.
